comment: Ballistic Dynamics stances: the shooter's body in each position, for the shooter layer (ADR 0005). Gameplay figures are estimated and say so.

provenance.hold_inertia_kg_m2: estimated: the pitch inertia of the arms and upper body that move with the gun standing unsupported; a fit for play, to be checked against high-speed footage of muzzle rise
provenance.recenter_deg_per_s2: estimated: the view kick's shape (a fast rise, a constant pull back, a slower return that stops at the aim without overshoot) follows the IW engine's weapon model (docs/decisions/0005-shooter-layer.md); the value is tuned for play and not yet measured on real shooters; firmer standing unsupported
provenance.return_percent: estimated: the view kick's shape (a fast rise, a constant pull back, a slower return that stops at the aim without overshoot) follows the IW engine's weapon model (docs/decisions/0005-shooter-layer.md); the value is tuned for play and not yet measured on real shooters
provenance.kick_clamp_deg: estimated: the view kick's shape (a fast rise, a constant pull back, a slower return that stops at the aim without overshoot) follows the IW engine's weapon model (docs/decisions/0005-shooter-layer.md); the value is tuned for play and not yet measured on real shooters
provenance.kick_pitch_sd_percent: estimated: shot-to-shot spread of the muzzle rise from the shooter's hold, about a sixth of the rise
provenance.kick_yaw_sd_percent: estimated: the sideways kick from an imperfect hold, about a third of the rise, either way
provenance.hip_kick_percent: estimated: a gun held at the hip without a cheek weld rises more than one in the shoulder
provenance.braced_reduction_percent: estimated: a settled, braced shooter takes the first shot of a string better than the shots that follow; tuned for play
provenance.settle_s: estimated: time for the shooter to re-brace after a shot
provenance.gun_kick_percent: estimated: the gun moves in the hands more than the eye moves off the aim (visual only)
provenance.gun_kick_accel_deg_per_s2: estimated: the hands' spring bringing the gun back (visual only)
provenance.gun_kick_decay_per_s: estimated: damping of the gun's motion in the hands (visual only)
provenance.gun_kick_max_deg: estimated: the most the gun moves in the hands (visual only)
provenance.hip_cone_min_moa: estimated: point-shooting from the hip without the sight, settled, standing unsupported; a design figure for play
provenance.hip_cone_max_moa: estimated: the hip cone fully opened by firing and moving, standing unsupported; a design figure for play
provenance.bloom_per_shot: estimated: how far one hip shot opens the cone (0 to 1); for play
provenance.bloom_per_deg_turned: estimated: how far turning at the hip opens the cone, per degree; for play
provenance.bloom_per_m_moved: estimated: how far moving at the hip opens the cone, per metre; for play
provenance.bloom_per_s_airborne: estimated: how fast the cone opens off the ground; for play
provenance.bloom_recovery_per_s: estimated: how fast the cone closes again, standing unsupported; for play
provenance.hold_wobble_moa: estimated: the wander of a held sight from breathing and pulse, standing unsupported: a few MOA standing, under one prone
provenance.wobble_period_s: estimated: about one breath, 3 to 5 s
